run_process_ner_data: run the CLI tool to process annotated eligibility criteria TSV into train and test NER datasets
transform_ner_slots: transform NER slot annotations and text by applying a text transformer and rebuilding label offsets
main_process_and_split: process an input TSV file, deduplicate samples, transform annotations, and split into train and test sets
parse_args_cli: parse command line arguments for input file, train output file, and test output file paths
review_transform_function: review the transform function that rebuilds NER label offsets after applying text transformations
